name: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate

D1.name: Monitoring, logging, analysis, remediation and performance

realExamNote: SOA-C03 replaced the SysOps Administrator – Associate exam (SOA-C02) on September 30, 2025. The real exam has 65 questions in 130 minutes and no hands-on labs.
scoreNote: AWS uses scaled scoring, so treat 720+ as a readiness signal, not a guarantee.
